subject.name: Pressers, Textile, Garment, and Related Materials
subject.summary: Pressers smooth and shape textiles and garments with hand irons, steam, or pressing equipment, handling, inspecting, and handing over finished pieces according to material and work order. O*NET 51-6021.00 and BLS 51-6021 are a standalone occupation; tasks may also include stain removal, machine cleaning and maintenance, or joining materials, with the actual division of labor depending on the site. Fabric and equipment processes must be verified through training and are not released on paper records alone.
